headlines.title: Oil routes in peril as attacks shut Saudi pipeline and Houthis threaten key waterway
headlines.summary: “This is the first day that Iran really started winning the war,” a Yemeni official said of Houthi territorial gains that give Tehran leverage over a second major waterway.

headlines.title: U.K. Parliament rejects bill to allow assisted dying for the terminally ill
headlines.summary: The defeat leaves Britain outside a growing list of European countries and 14 U.S. jurisdictions that allow some form of assisted suicide.

headlines.title: Rebels used Anthropic’s AI bot to develop guided weapons, report says
headlines.summary: Militants in Yemen sought to use a coding tool to produce guided rockets and missiles, the firm found, noting it was able to block some but not all the requests.

headlines.title: Six men accused of romance scams targeting more than 100 women will be extradited
headlines.summary: The men are accused of being members of an organized criminal network that defrauded women out of more than $6 million through online relationships, South African police said.

headlines.title: The Atlantic reaches a milestone for the latest date without a hurricane
headlines.summary: And according to to the National Hurricane Center, no hurricanes are on the horizon.

headlines.title: Xi lands in India for BRICS summit overshadowed by wars
headlines.summary: Wars in the Middle East and Ukraine, along with global energy security, are expected to dominate the summit.

headlines.title: North Korea fires ballistic missiles off eastern coast, Seoul says
headlines.summary: South Korea said it was closely exchanging information on the launches with the US and Japan.

headlines.title: CIA releases dozens of declassified documents on bin Laden prior to 9/11
headlines.summary: A briefer told Clinton in 1998 that bin Laden’s 'preferred option is to strike the US on its own soil in Washington'.

headlines.title: Mexico rescues eight from clandestine clinic run by violent Jalisco cartel
headlines.summary: Rescue operation in Jalisco uncovers cartel's hidden clinic, illegal drugs and weapons; six suspected guards arrested.

headlines.title: Passenger train derails in France, leaving 44 injured, 1 critical
headlines.summary: French train derailment sparks emergency response, with 130 firefighters and five medical teams dispatched to the scene.

headlines.title: Yemen's Houthis capture a Red Sea island in threat to shipping
headlines.summary: Iranian-backed Houthi rebels in Yemen have captured a strategic island in the Bab el-Mandeb Strait. The move threatens Saudi oil exports through a key commercial lane. And Saudi Arabia said it shut down a major oil pipeline as a precaution after it came under attack.

headlines.title: How shofars became the spiritual soundtrack of Rosh Hashanah
headlines.summary: Rosh Hashanah, the Jewish New Year, begins at sunset Friday. For many Jews around the world, a highlight of the holiday will be hearing the shofar: an animal's horn blown like a trumpet.

headlines.title: Amid war and sanctions, many Iranians are losing their jobs and struggling to get by
headlines.summary: Many Iranians lost their jobs because of the war and the U.S. blockade. Now some are even losing their backup jobs as sanctions tighten.

headlines.title: In photos: Remembering the Sept. 11 attacks, 25 years later
headlines.summary: Around the U.S., ceremonies commemorate the 25th anniversary of the Sept. 11th terror attacks in New York and at the Pentagon.

headlines.title: As diseases loom, CDC's response to measles deaths stirs fears about agency's reliability
headlines.summary: The worst U.S. measles outbreak in decades is growing and flu season is imminent. Experts are fretting about federal health data reliability after the CDC questioned two Pennsylvania measles deaths.

headlines.title: Merz cancels phone call with Trump
headlines.summary: Germany's Chancellor Friedrich Merz canceled a planned phone call with United States President Donald Trump, in the wake of the far-right Alternative for Germany party's election victory in the eastern state of Saxony-Anhalt and following a social media post by the US president celebrating the win.

headlines.title: ECB hikes rates again but remains cautious on future path
headlines.summary: BERLIN -- The European Central Bank (ECB) announced on Thursday that it will hike the key interest rates by 25 basis points.

headlines.title: UN chief warns against stoking Gulf tensions
headlines.summary: United Nations Secretary-General Antonio Guterres has expressed concerns about the recent escalation in the Strait of Hormuz as the United States and Iran exchange their biggest waves of strikes on shipping in recent days.

headlines.title: US' record-breaking $40t national debt raises global concern
headlines.summary: The US Department of the Treasury must find immediate ways to reduce the record-breaking national debt of over $40 trillion, or "feel the pain" of dealing with it later on, warned economists, who said if it remains high it will affect generations of Americans, lead to more borrowing and could weaken international trust in the world's largest economy.

headlines.title: IMF says uncertainty for global economy remains high after 6 months of US-Iran war
headlines.summary: WASHINGTON - The International Monetary Fund (IMF) said Thursday that the global economy has been resilient despite six months of war between the United States and Iran, but uncertainty remains high.

headlines.title: BRICS Finance Ministers & central bank chiefs voice concern about 'unilateral imposition' of tariffs
headlines.summary: BRICS finance ministers express concerns over unilateral tariffs, advocate for local currency trade solutions, and support multilateral trading systems.

headlines.summary: Bihar's traditional foods, sattu and makhana, showcase local flavors at the BRICS Summit, enhancing 'Brand Bihar' globally.
